• First, they ask to see your bank balance.
• Then, they delay your foreclosure request (claiming it takes 2 months).
• If you insist on faster processing, they shamelessly ask you to pay 2 extra EMIs.
• Even after waiting 2 months, they add an extra EMI + other charges in the foreclosure letter.
⚠️ Final Advice: Please don’t take a home loan from this company unless it’s the last option on earth. They trap customers with lies, hidden charges, and unethical practices.
